name: pterobot
description: v1.19.1: PROBE INSIGHT — a node that shows Unreachable on /status and /nodes now says WHY: every wings-daemon probe failure is classified (port closed / DNS / TLS / HTTP status) and printed on the board; a node whose servers are RUNNING is never called dead (green "Online (probe blocked)" — only a live daemon can run servers); STATUS_PROBE=false switches probing off, STATUS_PROBE_TIMEOUT tunes the budget. Plus v1.19.0: THE LIVE STATUS BOARD — /status is now a hosting-page-style NETWORK STATUS board: overall network RAM/Disk bars, a per-node breakdown with usage bars and used/free/total lines, nodes-available and servers-running counts — and the board EDITS ITSELF every 5 minutes (STATUS_REFRESH_MINUTES, 5-60), surviving bot restarts (DB-driven sweeper, exactly like giveaways). 🔄 Refresh-now and ⏹ Stop buttons on the board; posting /status again in the same channel supersedes the old board; boards retire after 24 h or an hour of dead panel instead of hammering forever. Plus v1.18.0: the climb engine (line-of-sight placement faces, bot climbs the build, jump assist, temporary cobblestone scaffolding) so /bot build produces complete houses, creative-mode builds straight from the creative inventory, self-defense that fights back zombies and players (/bot combat on|off), verified gathering, paced crafting, /giveaway, /plugins broken-jar removal, restart-safe creation sessions, /bot join on every panel and Minecraft version, the AI channel, AI server file sight, /install that never dead-ends, Pterodactyl panel Discord bot with NaraRouter AI chat that auto-diagnoses and auto-fixes your servers, /update self-editing, tickets with categories, files, backups, databases, full panel management, moderation suite, XP levels, an interactive /help center, and a Modrinth/CurseForge installer — 100% inside Discord.
